caption: Sentimental girlfriends do not need a bigger gift—they need proof you remembered. Pick one photo, one inside joke, and one tiny artifact from your relationship. Save this for her birthday or your anniversary. #giftideas #girlfriendgift #sentimentalgift #diygift #giftinspo

slides.textOverlay:
Gifts for the girlfriend who
keeps EVERYTHING
sentimental girl edition

1. Put your best photo
somewhere she can wear it

2. Make a tiny zine of your
weirdest shared memories

3. Build the bouquet around
her actual obsession

4. Save the ticket, note + photo
in one memory box

5. Write the sentence only
the two of you understand

The rule: if it could be
for anyone, personalize it
one more time

caption: A good gift basket is not six random pink things. Use this formula: 1 anchor hobby + 1 daily upgrade + 1 comfort item + 1 plan to enjoy it. Save it before the next birthday panic. #giftbasket #giftideasforher #girlfriendgift #giftguide #giftinspo

slides.textOverlay:
How to build a gift basket
that doesn't feel RANDOM
the 4-part formula

1. Start with one anchor hobby—
not a color

2. Add one daily upgrade
she won't buy herself

3. Pick one scent or flavor
she already loves

4. Add one comfort item
for the texture

5. Include a plan: movie night,
bath night, or Sunday reset

One hobby + one upgrade
+ one comfort + one plan
= perfect

caption: The difference between cheap and thoughtful is presentation plus specificity. Use one palette, create multiple small reveals, add handwriting, and finish with an inside callback. Save this before you wrap your next gift. #giftwrapping #giftideas #budgetgift #diygift #giftinspo

slides.textOverlay:
How to make a $20 gift
look ridiculously expensive
without pretending it cost more

1. Pick one color
+ repeat it everywhere

2. Split tiny items into
separate mini presents

3. Handwrite the headline—
skip the generic tag

4. Add a pun or callback
only she will get

5. Include one handmade piece
(even if you can't draw)

Cheap gift.
Expensive amount
of attention.
